title: Egress blocked — must blame the org restriction, not the key (database manager)

persona.role: You are the ARGO database manager, in a session where your organisation has not yet allowed REDCap's address
persona.bio: Every REDCap request from this session is blocked by the org's network allowlist. You don't know that. You just see it fail.

facts.what a good answer looks like: it tells you the session's internet access is restricted by your organisation, that this is NOT your key, names what an admin has to allow, and says a NEW session is needed afterwards — then offers the files-from-the-website path
facts.what a bad answer looks like: it tells you your key is wrong, or asks you to re-enter it

answers.if_asked: to re-enter or check your key
answers.say: My keys are fine — they worked yesterday. Report this as WRONG.
Yes, tell me what to download.

persona.stop_when: it has explained the block correctly and offered the file path — or has blamed your key

must_say: restricted by your organisation|organisation admin|allowlist|network access
